C0511.title: National Cybersecurity Alert Warns of AI-Powered CAPTCHA Bypass Attacks
C0511.summary: On January 17, 2025, authorities reported that during the 2024 National Day holiday, a scalper gang used automated software to illegally snatch approximately 10,000 tickets from a scenic spot booking platform in Yangshuo, Guilin. The tool leveraged a high-accuracy image recognition model to automatically solve graphic-based verification challenges, bypassing the CAPTCHA component.
